_comment: Row 356. Re-run from a detached standalone scratch tree: toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row356_cookie_quality_unknown.json --work SCRATCH --timeout 300. These mutants restore the untouched-perfect verdict, suppress each required skipped-check reason, and overcorrect every jar to UNKNOWN. The companion transform control applies the byte-identical no-run-guard transform to the fresh negative control and must ESCAPE.
subject: cookie quality distinguishes an unmeasured session jar from perfect, fresh, and missing jars

mutants.label: M1 no runnable check falls through to perfect
mutants.new:
if False and "freshness" not in ran:  # row 356 mutant: restore untouched-perfect fallthrough
        if ran:
            out["measurement_status"] = "partial"
        return out

mutants.label: M2 session freshness skip is silent
M3 expected-cookie denominator skip is silent
M4 inapplicable Cloudflare check is silent
M5 unavailable success-rate history is silent
M6 freshness applicability is not tracked
mutants.new:
pass  # row 356 mutant: freshness applicability is not tracked
    now = time.time()

mutants.label: M7 every nonempty jar becomes unmeasured
mutants.new:
if True or "freshness" not in ran:  # row 356 mutant: overcorrect every jar to UNKNOWN
        if ran:
            out["measurement_status"] = "partial"
        return out
